title: Crafting Recovery
description: Crafting Recovery lets you break items back down into base materials, enhancing reclaimation of resources, by adding intiutive reversal recipes for early-game items.
body: Crafting Recovery adds additional and intuitive reverse-crafting recipes to Minecraft, letting players break items back down into their basic materials directly through the crafting grid. Wool becomes string, tools return sticks, signs and rails can be reclaimed, and dozens of common survival items now give you part of their original components back when crafted alone. Every conversion is carefully balanced to feel vanilla-friendly, lightweight, and logical—no machines, no GUIs, just simple survival crafting. Perfect for long-term worlds, tight resource runs, skyblock maps, and any playstyle where every stick, scrap, and string counts.
